family_summary: AI-built pages generally avoid the imagery defects seen on the originals (broken thumbnails, tofu icon glyphs, Font Awesome dependence, oversized glyphs) by using no icon fonts and cleaner image handling, while keeping the same overall subject and illustration style, though a few new issues appear such as light sponsor logos vanishing on white tiles and unaligned stacked illustrations.

value_map.light logos blank on white tiles: light logos blank on white tiles

attributes.summary: AI-built pages mostly show no broken images or oversized glyphs (2 of 3 sites with values report none), whereas the originals had broken thumbnails, tofu icon squares and a giant orange glyph; one AI-built page instead has light sponsor logos disappearing on white tiles.
Both AI-built sites with this tag use no icon font, whereas both originals relied on Font Awesome icons.

Where compared, AI-built pages keep the same illustration style and photo subject as the originals (flat green line-art, motorsport editorial photos), with one AI-built page adding three unaligned stacked green illustrations not noted on its original.

AI-built pages typically use few cropped images (2 of 3 sites) or uniform cropped frames, while the originals were more varied, with varied frame sizes, few cropped images, or many large natural-size photos.

AI-built logos are split between a cyan italic SVG wordmark and a stamp-style raster logo, compared with a blue italic SVG wordmark and a script-and-serif wordmark on the originals, so one pair matches in form with a color shift and the other differs in style.
